overview: Arkhe(n) Platform is a quantum consensus dashboard featuring animated Ω' coherence gauges, rotating 3D icosahedrons (EEG Manifold), real-time relay transaction monitoring, and a quorum node network map. Built on the Internet Computer, it offers full governance via proposals and voting, neurofeedback session control, cross-chain metrics, and comprehensive system settings — all wrapped in a deep OKLCH dark theme with cyan, neon-purple, and electric-blue accents.
features: Animated Ω' coherence gauge with sparkline history
Real-time relay transaction log with geo-mapped nodes
8-city quantum consensus network map with pulsing arcs
Trading tab: DEX scanner, arbitrage feed, cross-chain bridge
Neurofeedback tab: live EEG metrics, cymatic parameters, session presets
Quorum tab: governance proposals, voting, constitutional invariants
Settings tab: user profile, hardware profiles, therapeutic protocols
OKLCH dark theme with cyan/neon-purple/electric-blue accents
